_source: docs/relic-spec.md section 9 (3), band assignment: relic>=60 with lp_residual<40 is not dormant but unclear / reason='high aggregate but cannot exit'. Read the aggregate alone and the response looks fine, so leaving the reason undrawn means the user reads it as 'nice score'. Hence a fixture of its own to pin it down.
name: High score, no exit

axes.label: Holder spread
axes.blurb: How widely the real holders are spread, after removing pool, exchange, burn and insider wallets.

axes.label: Liquidity left
axes.blurb: Real quote-side liquidity still in the pool(s), and whether that liquidity is burned, locked, or still pullable.

axes.label: Creator overhang
axes.blurb: Residual control the creator still holds: remaining supply, recent large moves, and whether mint or freeze authority is still live.

axes.label: Trading floor
axes.blurb: How consistently the token still trades day over day. This measures persistence of fills, not price.

axes.label: Afterglow
axes.blurb: On-chain traces of lingering attention: new first-time holders, breadth of distinct active wallets, and holder-count trend.

disclaimer: Survival-signal summary, not a prediction of price or revival.
